name: HELIOS Unified Control Workflow

authority.governanceEvidence: one SharePoint HELIOS_CONTROL_PLANE_CURRENT.md plus immutable evidence
authority.assistantDigest: OpenAI / ALVIS through bounded read-and-plan tools

hardRules: Every cross-system update carries correlationId, runId, sourceSha, stage, status, approvalState, nextAction, and evidence links.
A connector updates one configured permanent object and may not create a duplicate master record.
The unified workflow emits one canonical event into the existing HELIOS Fabric rather than calling every provider directly.
GitHub protected environments are the only deployment authority.
No secret value is written to source, logs, chat, Slack, Linear, SharePoint, or Azure DevOps.
Tenant activation and machine activation are separate approvals.
Production remains disabled until an approved exact-SHA what-if and a separate deployment approval succeed.
